visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, glasses, and blue tape covering his mouth stands in a kitchen. He wears a black t-shirt and a thick gold chain, waving at the camera while standing behind a green bowl and a KORG keyboard. (2) The scene cuts to the man crouching by a white refrigerator in a kitchen with purple-tinged lighting. He reaches in and pulls out a large plastic bag filled with ice cubes while the timestamp on the screen changes. (3) He stands back at the counter and uses scissors to cut the top of the ice bag. He then pours a large amount of clear ice cubes into the green textured glass bowl, looking directly ahead with a neutral expression. (4) He crouches down again to the refrigerator to retrieve a blue plastic bottle. Returning to the counter, he opens the bottle and pours a clear liquid over the ice until the green bowl is nearly full. (5) A yellow sponge-like object is thrown at the man's face twice. He removes his glasses, sets them on the counter, and prepares to lean forward over the ice-filled bowl while the digital clock overlay displays erratic times. (6) He submerses his entire face into the cold liquid. As his head moves, his nose and chin press various keys on the KORG keyboard, creating a melody until he finally pulls his head back, gasping for air.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Low-level ambient room tone with subtle shifting of clothing as the subject waves silently. (2) A mechanical click and a low-frequency hum as the refrigerator door is opened and quickly closed. (3) Intense, high-frequency plastic crinkling sounds followed by the percussive and bright clinking of ice cubes falling into glass. (4) A sharp metallic click followed by the rhythmic glugging of liquid being poured steadily into the ice bowl. (5) A sharp, wet slapping sound occurs as an object hits skin, followed by a brief, tense silence. (6) A large splash of water transitions immediately into bright, electronic synthesizer notes playing a simple major-key melody. (7) Rapid splashing and loud, strained gasping for air as the subject pulls his head out of the bowl.
